title: Batelco and Ericsson expand 5G network coverage and introduce AI-powered capabilities in the Kingdom of Bahrain
summary: On the sidelines of Gateway Gulf 2026
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
Batelco by Beyon and Ericsson -agreement signing ceremony at Gateway Gulf. Image Courtesy: Batelco by Beyon

On the sidelines of Gateway Gulf 2026

Press Release

  • Batelco is expanding its mobile broadband network with Ericsson Radio Access Network (RAN) and core network solutions to enhance coverage, capacity and performance across the Kingdom of Bahrain.
  • The two companies also enabling AI-powered RAN capabilities and 5G Advanced, alongside the modernisation of Batelco’s core network with cloud-native technologies.
  • The collaboration supports Bahrain Economic Vision 2030 and the development of future-ready digital infrastructure.

Manama, Bahrain: On the sidelines of Gateway Gulf 2026, Batelco by Beyon and Ericsson (NASDAQ: ERIC) have announced an expansion of their partnership to develop and modernize Batelco’s mobile broadband network across the Kingdom of Bahrain, with the announcement made in the presence of H.E. Shaikh Abdulla bin Khalifa Al Khalifa, the Chairman of Beyon Group.

The collaboration combines Ericsson’s Radio Access Network (RAN) solutions and cloud-based core network technologies to enhance network coverage, capacity and performance. It also includes testing Ericsson’s AI-native Scheduler for Link Adaptation, an AI-powered RAN solution that helps the network adjust the amount of data transmitted to devices in response to changing radio conditions, with the aim of improving download efficiency and data throughput. 

This initiative supports Batelco’s ambition to deliver faster, more reliable connectivity and enhanced digital experiences for consumers and businesses, while preparing its network for the future of sixth-generation (6G) technologies in the Kingdom.

As part of the expansion, Batelco will deploy Ericsson’s latest RAN solutions, including high-performing Massive MIMO systems, which help improve download performance and network energy efficiency while reducing equipment footprint. The deployment will enhance coverage and capacity, supporting more stable connectivity and improved mobile network experience.

In parallel, Batelco will modernize its core network with Ericsson’s cloud-native dual-mode 5G Core solution, including upgrades to the packet core and Unified Data Management systems. Batelco will also develop its cloud infrastructure by transitioning from NFVi to Ericsson Cloud Native Infrastructure Solution, ensuring it is fully prepared for the next phases of cloud-native transformation. The modernization will help Batelco manage growing data demands and deliver more reliable digital services, while providing a flexible foundation for advanced connectivity services.

Maitham Abdulla Batelco by Beyon CEO, commented: “Our continued investment in expanding and modernizing our network reflects our commitment to delivering an exceptional connectivity experience across the Kingdom of Bahrain. By enhancing coverage and capacity while deploying advanced technologies, we are building a more efficient network that meets the evolving needs of consumers and businesses. Our collaboration with Ericsson reinforces our commitment to supporting the Kingdom of Bahrain’s digital transformation ambitions.”

Petra Schirren, President of Ericsson Gulf Region, says: “Our collaboration with Batelco brings together advanced radio solutions, AI-enabled capabilities and cloud-native technologies to enhance network performance and customer experiences. By expanding connectivity, strengthening 5G standalone readiness and exploring 5G-Advanced capabilities, we are supporting Batelco in building a more efficient and future-ready network, opening new opportunities for innovation and laying the foundation for 6G.”

The collaboration reinforces Batelco and Ericsson’s commitment to developing the Kingdom of Bahrain’s digital infrastructure and supporting Bahrain Economic Vision 2030. By combining advanced mobile connectivity services with intelligent, cloud-native network technologies, the companies are contributing to a future-ready network capable of meeting the Kingdom’s evolving digital needs.

This press release has been issued by Beyon Corporate Communications & Sustainability Department. For further information, please contact Public.Relations@beyon.com

Batelco by Beyon is the leading provider of innovative telecommunications and digital services that connect and empower people, enable businesses, and enrich society. 

Batelco serves the enterprise, consumer, government and global markets in one of the most competitive environments in the MENA region through its comprehensive portfolio which includes fixed and mobile telecoms, internet connectivity, cloud services, and Data Center solutions. With sophisticated infrastructure solutions. Batelco offers dependable and diverse solutions to meet growing international capacity demands.
